review_identity: Language-model evidence synthesis plus automated PatAgent checklist; not expert certification or Pat Walters endorsement.
purpose: Optional constrained reconstruction of missing CCD ligand heavy atoms and explicit named Zn2+ Amber/TIP3P model support in DynaMol. Validate structure identity, unchanged observed coordinates, atom correspondence, opt-in intent, uncertainty labels, and finite compatible native force-field setup; no biological pose, metal coordination accuracy, affinity or converged dynamics claim.

reproducibility.budget: Isolated data/integration-checks/chemistry-repair only; user datasets read or copied, never edited. Up to four small organic component cases (≤80 heavy atoms), ≤32 deterministic conformer attempts each, ≤200 local MMFF/UFF iterations per attempt. At most 2 CPU threads, 300 seconds per native parameterization/test process. OpenMM finite-energy/force-field smoke systems ≤50000 atoms, ≤100 bounded minimization iterations if needed, zero dynamics integration/production MD. No GPU, cloud, broad molecule generation or long jobs.
reproducibility.budget_note: Actual outputs use task-specific sibling directories under the predeclared integration-checks root. Two incomplete 1PE copies received eight conformer attempts each; one native ligand smoke and one complete complex preparation used at most two CPU threads and zero dynamics. Whole-complex setup retained five organic residues spanning three CCD identities; existing validated parameter caches were available.

data.policy: Full CCD identity/bond order/stereochemistry must be unambiguous and observed atom names/elements a compatible subset. Preserve observed heavy-atom coordinates exactly; label new coordinates as modeled with seed, atom map, missing-atom inventory and low-confidence provenance. Only explicit per-residue opt-in may reconstruct or exclude. Reject unsupported graph/stereo/covalent identity, too-few/degenerate anchors or gross clashes. Named monatomic Zn2+ requires matching element/declared-charge consistency; model uses installed Amber TIP3P nonbonded parameters, not a bonded/polarizable coordination or oxidation-state model.

validation.status: Scoped chemical identity, coordinate preservation, parameter translation and review controls passed. No scientific validation of missing coordinates or metal coordination is claimed.
validation.scope: Read-only independent review of final chemistry paths, bounded synthetic regressions, actual constrained ligand completion and native Amber/OpenMM setup. Five actual browser cases verify missing-loop controls, per-residue repair/remove intent, resize/persistence/reset and canvas/fullscreen/header bounds.

native_parameter_translation.note: Native Amber versus converted OpenMM XML consistency at the bound pose and two deterministic small perturbations; not experimental validation.

results.ui_static_review: Loop option remains selectable before Prep with no-gap explanation; ligand default retains observed molecules and requires explicit repair/remove, submission and readiness share ligand_actions; modeled-coordinate and ion-model limits visible. Browser behavior is not inferred from this code review.

browser.scope: Chrome tests with actual isolated source datasets and real dry inspection/readiness; final Prep request intercepted to inspect choices. Native preparation covered separately by recorded real worker result. No user-library writes.

limitations: No known experimental reference positions for the omitted ligand atoms; no pose accuracy, statistical uncertainty intervals, affinity, convergence or production-MD claim.

Repair is bounded to at least three noncollinear observed anchors, one connected observed core, at most eight missing atoms and half of the ligand; missing ring atoms and ambiguous identity remain unsupported.
The 1.6 angstrom gross overlap screen is not a binding-site energy or plausibility validation. Local MMFF/UFF energy ranks candidates only within this bounded procedure.

Named monatomic ions use installed water-compatible fixed-charge 12-6 nonbonded parameters. Unknown/mismatched oxidation states and unsupported models remain errors; catalytic coordination chemistry is not validated.

Original ligand heavy atoms are preserved exactly in stored physical frames in the exercised case; newly generated coordinate records roundtrip to within 5.4e-6 angstrom because canonical physical coordinates use finite precision.

comparison.notes: Deterministic implementation controls and bounded parameter consistency are not independent scientific replicas or a statistical validation of unobserved coordinates. No uncertainty interval is fabricated.

modeling.note: No dynamics integration or scientific convergence claim.
